description.value: The White Crystal Inn is a ski-resort hotel located within the Big White Ski Resort controlled recreational area, roughly 56 km southeast of Kelowna in BC's Okanagan highlands. As part of a major destination ski resort, it sits at high elevation in a village-style mountain setting that also offers summer eBike tours and trail activities. The resort operates on a seasonal model, closing in spring and reopening for summer and winter seasons.
